description: This file contains extension methods for integrating Kubernetes hosting support into Orleans silos and services. It provides methods to add Kubernetes hosting capabilities to the silo builder and service collection, configuring related options and dependencies.

classes.name: KubernetesHostingExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods to add Kubernetes hosting support to Orleans silo builders and service collections.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting
methods.description: Adds Kubernetes hosting support to an ISiloBuilder, with optional configuration for KubernetesHostingOptions.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting
methods.description: Adds Kubernetes hosting support to an ISiloBuilder with a configuration action for options.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting
methods.description: Adds Kubernetes hosting support to IServiceCollection with default options.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting
methods.description: Adds Kubernetes hosting support to IServiceCollection with a configuration action for options.
